title: Workmanship Warranties: Concern Reporting and Inspection Standards by Plan
content:
The standards below apply when a customer reports a concern under a Workmanship Warranties plan and, where the plan requires it, when a network inspection determines coverage.

| Standard | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after the customer discovered a concern within which it must be reported | 10 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Odometer reading must be given when the concern is reported | no | yes | no | no | yes | yes |
| A network inspection must determine coverage before any remedy | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Business days within which the inspection is offered after the report (0 means no inspection) | 0 | 2 | 3 | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Photos taken at the inspection | 2 | 4 | 6 | 6 | 8 | 10 |
| A structural concern inspection includes an electronic measurement | no | no | no | no | no | yes |

## Points of reading

- **Report window.** The Chip Repair Guarantee allows 10 calendar days from the customer's discovery of a concern to its report; every other plan allows 30 calendar days.
- **Odometer at report.** The odometer reading must be given at report under the Calibration Workmanship Warranty, the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty; the other three plans do not require it.
- **Inspection.** Every plan except the Chip Repair Guarantee requires a network inspection to determine coverage before any remedy. The Chip Repair Guarantee's scheduling figure is 0, meaning no inspection.
- **Scheduling.** The inspection is offered within 2 business days of the report under the Calibration Workmanship Warranty and the Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty, and within 3 business days under the Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty, the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty.
- **Photos.** The photo count rises from 2 under the Chip Repair Guarantee to 10 under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty, as the table shows.
- **Structural measurement.** Only the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty includes an electronic measurement in a structural concern inspection.

Q. Must a Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty customer give an odometer reading when reporting a leak?
A. No. The odometer requirement at report is no under that plan.
